{{Quote|They may think they have struck a blow against the Trade Federation. But they will think again when Dorvalla is forced to make restitution to us.|Unidentified Neimoidian subaltern|<ref name="CoD" />}}
This  '''individual''' was a [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[subaltern]] to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Nap Lagard]] aboard the [[Acquisitor (Lucrehulk-class battleship)|''Acquisitor'']], a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]]<ref name="CoD" /> in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].<ref name="tnec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].</ref>
